plugin.name: AllstarCoding
plugin.description: A full-lifecycle software engineering team: conductor + resident helper + one-shot stage subagents, covering requirements, prototype, architecture, tasks, development, review, whitebox, blackbox (optional self-test + user review), deployment and finalization.
agent.allstar.name: Allstar Conductor
agent.allstar.description: Pipeline conductor: schedules only, never authors. Orchestrates the 13-stage pipeline, guards user confirmation gates, maintains state.md, and drives rework loops.
agent.helper.name: Helper
agent.helper.description: Resident execution proxy: runs escalated commands for all members after a safety pre-review; the sole executor under the conductor's no-file-touch discipline.
team.pipeline.name: AllstarCoding
team.pipeline.description: The full engineering pipeline: requirements → prototype gate → architecture → tasks → dev/review loops → whitebox → blackbox (optional self-test + user review) → deploy → finalize.
